channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Trevor Ariza | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Trevor Ariza from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: John Wall on LeBron James, Trevor Ariza, JR Smith, Kevin Love, Tristan Thompson, Bradley Beal, Markieff Morris
item.description:
“Me and Kyrie, we matchin’ up. I’m taking [Bradley Beal] over [JR Smith]. You got [LeBron James] over Trevor Ariza. Kevin Love and Markieff Morris, I’m taking Kevin Love but Markieff Morris can shoot threes and post up. I’m taking [Marcin] Gortat over Tristan Thompson,”

John Wall on LeBron James, Trevor Ariza, JR Smith, Kevin Love, Tristan Thompson, Bradley Beal, Markieff Morris, Jan 19, 2023. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Trevor Ariza
item.description:
Ryan Ward:Frank Vogel on Trevor Ariza:

“We're hoping to have him potentially practice with the G League next week.... If that's necessary to get more live work. ... No update on the exact timeline.”

Frank Vogel on Trevor Ariza, Dec 9, 2021. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Trevor Ariza
item.description:
Mike Trudell:Vogel on Trevor Ariza:

“Right now he’s still out with the sore ankle. We’re in the process of evaluating that day-to-day.”

Frank Vogel on Trevor Ariza, Oct 2, 2021. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Neil Olshey on Trevor Ariza, Jusuf Nurkic, Zach Collins
item.description:
Neil Olshey said Wednesday.

“On one hand, I’m excited to see our guys play again. You know, the season ended so abruptly, we were just getting healthy. We were three days from getting ‘Nurk’ (Jusuf Nurkic) back and Zach (Collins) was on the horizon-- he was about three weeks out from returning. At that point, Trevor (Ariza) was in the starting lineup, so the exciting thing is to see the guys out playing basketball again. I missed basketball.”

Neil Olshey on Trevor Ariza, Jusuf Nurkic, Zach Collins, Jul 1, 2020. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Thomas Bryant on Trevor Ariza
item.description:
Fred Katz:Thomas Bryant on if any Wizards vets have shocked him with how good shape they're in:

“Trevor. That man can go. What is it? Like, 15 years for him? And he's still playing at a top level like he is. Putting up the numbers like he is, it's amazing. He takes hit work very seriously”

Thomas Bryant on Trevor Ariza, Feb 4, 2019. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Trevor Ariza, Tomas Satoransky
item.description:
Brooks on advice he gives Satoransky about going against Curry and the Warriors:

“It's (Satoransky), Brad, Trevor, Jeff, TB playing against five All-Stars. It's gonna be tough. We've just got to compete.... You've got to give yourself a chance by just playing hard.”

Scott Brooks on Trevor Ariza, Tomas Satoransky, Jan 24, 2019. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Trevor Ariza
item.description:
Fred Katz:Scott Brooks on Trevor Ariza’s improving versatility:

“When he first got here and I had my first talk with him: ‘I expect more from you than you just being a spot-up shooter. We have to expand. You're 33. You have a lot more years in this league and you can keep improving.’”

Scott Brooks on Trevor Ariza, Jan 21, 2019. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Trevor Ariza
item.description:
During #Rockets @VegasSummerNBA game vs GS,D'Antoni on broadcast talking about Ariza:

“You hate to lose Trevor. He was important in so many different ways. He will be sorely missed.”

Mike D'Antoni on Trevor Ariza, Jul 8, 2018. Source: Twitter @KPRC2AdamW.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Trevor Ariza
item.description:
“I looked over at [Rockets forward] Trevor Ariza in the middle of the fourth quarter and we just both said to each other, 'This is fun; this is what you love about NBA basketball.'If you can't push through for 48 minutes in this type of environment, you don't love the game.”

Stephen Curry on Trevor Ariza, May 27, 2018. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Trevor Ariza
item.description:
Steve Kerr on the double-tech:

“I thought it was unfair, but we'll take it up with the league. He committed a hard foul, but he held Ariza up and didn't allow him to get hurt. And then Ariza shoved him. It didn't seem like a double-technical to me.”

Steve Kerr on Trevor Ariza, May 21, 2018. Source: Twitter @melissarohlin.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Trevor Ariza, Eric Gordon, PJ Tucker
item.description:
Meanwhile, Warriors coach Steve Kerr and his staff spent the past three days trying to find solutions for all these unique challenges.

“Well, they do a ton of switching, like we do, and they've got a lot of guys who they may not be the Greek Freak (Antetokounmpo) or (Durant), but they're good-sized guys with Trevor Ariza, PJ Tucker, Eric Gordon,”

Steve Kerr on Trevor Ariza, Eric Gordon, PJ Tucker, May 20, 2018. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Daryl Morey, Trevor Ariza
item.description:
They are an unconscionable 34-1 when Harden, Paul and Clint Capela play together.

“We respect the hell out of them. We respect all those guys and we know — you hear a lot from their GM [Daryl Morey] — but James, and CP and Trevor Ariza, those guys knuckle down and play. They leave the talking up to the GM and whoever else,”

Kevin Durant on Daryl Morey, Trevor Ariza, Mar 8, 2018. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Austin Rivers on Trevor Ariza
item.description:
“The whole game was filled with cheap shots. So I'm not calling anyone out. But he [Trevor] had given Blake a little something and he walked towards our bench. So what do you expect is going to happen? I started talking to him. If I cheap-shotted James Harden, their best player, and I walked down by the Houston bench. You don't think anybody on their bench would've started talking to me? Okay then.”

Austin Rivers on Trevor Ariza, Jan 18, 2018. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Trevor Ariza, Gerald Green
item.description:
Mark Berman:Mike D'Antoni on Trevor Ariza and Gerald Green suspended for 2 games:

“We shouldn't have initiated, shouldn't have gone in (the Clippers locker room).”

Mike D'Antoni on Trevor Ariza, Gerald Green, Jan 18, 2018. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: David Griffin on LeBron James, Channing Frye, Trevor Ariza, Chandler Parsons
item.description:
Griffin told ESPN this week.

“We were concerned what would it look like for him because Kyrie had been really active with us in recruiting everybody that was going to come if LeBron didn't come. And was very successful as a recruiter. [Gordon] Hayward wanted to come, Chandler Parsons would have come, Channing Frye would have come, Trevor Ariza would have come. Like, we had an opportunity to get everybody, and he had done a great job for us. So there was a little bit of trepidation on our part of, 'Is he going to feel like we've asked him to go backwards?' And from the very beginning, it was like, 'Griff, all I want to do is win.' So he's been very receptive to it.”

David Griffin on LeBron James, Channing Frye, Trevor Ariza, Chandler Parsons, Jun 1, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Ryan Anderson on Trevor Ariza
item.description:
New Rockets forwardRyan Anderson:

“A big part of Houston's pitch to me was the fact that guys like Trevor Ariza were getting 200 wide open three-point shots. For me, I haven't had a wide open three-point shot in a long time.”

Ryan Anderson on Trevor Ariza, Jul 6, 2016. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Ernie Grunfeld on Trevor Ariza
item.description:
Michael Lee:Ernie Grunfeld on Trevor Ariza:

“We’re disappointed. We made our very best offer. He elected to go elsewhere. We wish him the best”

Ernie Grunfeld on Trevor Ariza, Jul 12, 2014. Source: Twitter @MrMichaelLee.

item.title: DJ Augustin on Trevor Ariza
item.description:
Nick Friedell:Augustin on Ariza:

“He's long so it was tough to score on him, even to get open. I think it was a good strategy by them.”

DJ Augustin on Trevor Ariza, Apr 23, 2014. Source: Twitter @NickFriedell.

item.title: Ernie Grunfeld on Trevor Ariza
item.description:
Wizards president Ernie Grunfeld said in a statement.

“Emeka’s defensive presence and rebounding ability will combine with Trevor’s versatility to add new dimensions to our frontcourt,and both players fit in very well with the type of team-first culture that we have been working to establish.”

Ernie Grunfeld on Trevor Ariza, Jun 20, 2012. Source: Washington Times.
